lessons.keep: Keep the subject stable when demonstrating visual variation.
lessons.avoid: Avoid using a changing gallery as the only explanation of preference learning.
lessons.open: Generation provenance, learning behavior, parameter effects, exact motion, image rights and all audio delivery remain unverified.
try: Use one Tin product image to compare three explicit style settings with the control visible.
Show one preference action, its saved state and the next output that reflects it.

comparison.story: Name the model and its aesthetic range. → Show stylistic variation without changing subject. → Present visual direction and personal preference. → Claim adaptation and expand output variety. → Make controllable variation visible. → Reinforce range and give a destination.
comparison.motion: Reference cards surround profile centers, image planes layer around a figure, control values change and the final image field contracts. Exact paths are unverified. Sampling scope: 1 fps unless a closer window is recorded.
